RESUME

SAMIT SANJAY GANGURDE

Phone: 7718833220   |   Email: gangurdesamit@gmail.com   |   Location: Mumbai, India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Business Transformation & Excellence leader with 11+ years of progressive experience across consulting, manufacturing, logistics, FMCG, pharma retail, and e-commerce sectors. Proven track record of orchestrating enterprise-wide Lean Six Sigma deployments, spearheading end-to-end digital transformation programs (Agentic AI, GenAI, RPA, Copilot), and building large-scale capability pipelines — having trained 500+ practitioners across Black Belt, Green Belt, and Yellow Belt levels. Adept at translating C-suite strategy into measurable operational outcomes, leading cross-functional stakeholder governance, and delivering process excellence for global clients across US and EMEA regions. Seeking Senior Manager / Director / Head of Function roles in Business Excellence, Transformation & Operational Leadership.

INDUSTRIES SERVED

Consulting  |  Manufacturing  |  Automotive  |  Service  |  FMCG  |  Dental Lab  |  Pharma Retail  |  E-commerce  |  Logistics

CORE COMPETENCIES

✦ Business Transformation & Strategy ✦ Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt LSSBB) ✦ Change Management & Cultural Transformation ✦ Digital Transformation (AI / GenAI / RPA) ✦ Capability Building & Large-Scale Training ✦ Process Re-engineering & Waste Elimination ✦ Cross-functional Stakeholder Governance ✦ Performance Dashboards & Analytics (Power BI) ✦ Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

CERTIFICATIONS

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt — ISEL

Lean Six Sigma Green Belt — Benchmark Six Sigma

PMP — PDU Completed (Exam Pending)

ISO 9001:2015 Internal Auditor

Business Analytics & Data Mining Modeling Using R

Experience: ISO 14001 (EMS) | IATF 16949 | ISO 22000 (FSMS)

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Analytics & Reporting: Power BI, MINITAB, Advanced Excel (VBA & Macros), MIS Dashboards

Digital & Automation: Agentic AI, Generative AI, UiPath RPA, Copilot Bots, Excel Automation

Lean & Quality Tools: VSM, PDCA, Kaizen, 5S, TPM, MOST, Time & Motion Studies, 7 QC Tools

Process & Quality Stds: APQP, PPAP, 8D, CAPA, 5-Why, FTA, OEE, DMS, SOP Writing

Design Software: AutoCAD, CATIA V5

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

1. Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd.	Dec 2025 – Till Date

Associate Manager – Business Transformation (Dec 2025 – Present)  |  Prev: Manager – Business Excellence (Jul 2023 – Nov 2025)  |  Mumbai

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

Lead multi-country business transformation programs for clients across US and EMEA regions, covering end-to-end Talent & HR domain process redesign and standardization.

Spearhead identification and implementation of digital transformation initiatives leveraging Agentic AI, GenAI, RPA, Copilot Bots, and Excel Macros — driving measurable productivity uplift.

Own the full automation lifecycle: opportunity scoping, entitlement study, delivery team & client alignment, implementation, and post-go-live stabilization.

Establish performance governance frameworks — building dashboards and operational reports that enable data-driven decision-making for senior leadership.

Execute business excellence and compliance programs focused on agent productivity optimization, quality monitoring, and turnaround improvement.

Collaborate with cross-functional global teams to streamline processes, reduce cycle times, and deliver continuous improvement.

2. Mahindra Logistics Limited (MLL)	Jul 2023 – Dec 2025

Manager – Business Excellence  |  Mumbai

Enterprise Process Excellence:

Spearheaded enterprise-wide Lean Six Sigma and productivity transformation across all business verticals, partnering directly with Vertical Heads to bridge organizational strategy with ground-level execution.

Drove diagnostics, gap assessments, and structured project deployment using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies across MLL's logistics network.

Capability Building (Scale Achieved — 500+ Practitioners):

Architected and led MLL's largest-ever practitioner capability program: Master Black Belts (20+), Green Belts (100+), Yellow Belts (400+).

Designed training content, review presentations, and Excel-based tools to simplify Lean/Six Sigma adoption for frontline employees.

Mentored project teams and individual belt practitioners through full project lifecycle — from problem definition to benefit realization.

Designed a no-cost E-Learning platform using Microsoft Sites to enable Yellow Belt self-paced learning — replacing the need for a paid LMS.

Stakeholder Governance & Digital Enablement:

Facilitated executive-level project governance reviews with Vertical Heads, Business Heads, Cluster Heads, and Site Leads — ensuring business alignment and benefit realization accountability.

Designed Power BI dashboards, visual MIS reports, and leadership review decks for multi-level organizational visibility.

Deployed integrated KPI monitoring Excel solution with Dashboard and CAPA tracking, providing site-level performance visibility to central leadership.

Applied Daily Management System (DMS) concepts to enable ground-level performance tracking and rapid-response issue resolution.

Delivered multiple process automation initiatives using Excel VBA, reducing manual effort significantly.

3. Wellness Forever Medicare Pvt. Ltd.	Oct 2021 – Jul 2023

Asst. Manager – Operational Excellence (Director's Office)  |  Mumbai

Drove end-to-end digital transformation and business process improvement as part of the Director's Office, with direct accountability to senior leadership for project outcomes.

Led 8 high-impact transformation projects across pharma retail and e-commerce operations, including Mobile Application for Pharma Retail Ecom, WABA Bot for multi-user-journey marketing automation, and Last Mile Delivery improvement (Lean Six Sigma).

Executed full-cycle process re-engineering (As-Is analysis → To-Be design → pilot → implementation) for multiple operational processes.

Automated the end-to-end salary processing flow from HRMS to Accounting, eliminating manual intervention and reducing payroll cycle time.

Established Simian Lab — an Automation Lab initiative (Quality Kiosk) — to institutionalize innovation within the organization.

Improved platform search (App & Web) and Order Management System (OMS), directly enhancing customer experience metrics.

Collaborated with L&D to develop process training content and coordinated training execution as program coordinator.

4. Paradigm Services Pvt. Ltd.	Nov 2018 – Oct 2021

Sr. Consultant – Operational Excellence  |  Client Sites

Led and mentored cross-functional operational excellence teams at multiple client plant locations across FMCG, manufacturing, and service sectors.

Delivered 6 Lean Six Sigma projects, 1 Kaizen implementation, and multiple diagnostic studies — producing documented productivity and quality improvements.

Conducted Lean/Six Sigma Site Maturity Assessments and developed tailored improvement roadmaps, driving sustained cultural and process change.

Facilitated certification training programs in Lean, Six Sigma (Yellow & Green Belt), VSM, Process Mapping, Kaizen, TPM, 5S, and MIS for client workforces.

Managed end-to-end project planning, stakeholder reporting, and delivery tracking across multiple concurrent client engagements.

Supported market research, monthly MIS reporting, and statistical analysis using MINITAB for FMCG sector clients.

Gained foundational experience in Robotic Process Automation (RPA) using UiPath.

5. Fairfield Manufacturing Co.	Aug 2014 – Nov 2018

Mechanical Engineer (Manufacturing)  |  Pune

Led APQP & PPAP documentation, and implemented QMS ISO 9001 and EMS ISO 14001 systems, maintaining zero non-conformance across annual audits.

Executed Lean Six Sigma project on Electroplating Process Improvement — achieving process parameter optimization, rejection reduction, layout standardization, and COPQ reduction.

Implemented Lean, TPM, 5S, Poka-yoke, and OEE measurement systems on the shop floor, driving continuous improvement culture.

Conducted supplier quality audits, CFT-led root cause analysis (8D, 5-Why, FTA, CAPA), and implemented countermeasures for in-house and customer-end defects.

Managed new product development from concept to production layout, including prototype development and new line setup.

Handled plant capacity planning, sheet metal part costing, and design work using CATIA and AutoCAD.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS

Qualification Institution Year Result B.E. (Mechanical Engineering) Dr. D.Y. Patil College of Engineering, Pune 2010 – 2014 61.53% 12th Science – Electronics (HSC) Sharadashram Jr. College of Voc. Science, Dadar 2008 – 2010 74.50% 10th (SSC) Sharadashram Vidya Mandir, Dadar 2008 79.53%

PERSONAL DETAILS

Date of Birth: 2nd December 1992

Gender: Male

Permanent Address: Ganesh Wadi, New Mill Road, Kurla (W), Mumbai – 400070

Languages Known: English, Hindi, Marathi

Hobbies: Reading, Exploring New Places, Adventure Sports

DECLARATION

I hereby declare that the above information is true to the best of my knowledge and belief.

Place: Mumbai	Samit Sanjay Gangurde
